text:
customer_jim: Hey team — hitting a weird failure when using response_format=structured_json + strict mode. Our client gets a 200 with HTML body instead of JSON and our parser blows up. Repro below.

customer_jim: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt": "hello", "response_format": "structured_json", "json_mode": "strict"}'

customer_jim: Response headers show Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and body is an HTML error page. We only see this when upstream model times out (502/500).

support_ryan: thanks Jim — can you confirm this happens for both streaming and non-streaming calls?

customer_jim: non-streaming only, we haven't tried streaming for this endpoint. It's intermittent when there are transient backend errors.

eng_sophia: @support_ryan assigning to eng-runtime — sounds like content-type fallback during error handling. Is the gateway preferring upstream Content-Type over Accept/profile when response_format enforced? :thinking_face:

eng_infra_bot: [deploy-bot] Notice: gateway v3.14.2 handling of error responses patched in 2026-02-11 for CDN passthrough rules.

support_ryan: Can you paste the raw response headers & body (sanitized)? Also, which SDK/version?

customer_jim: Here's sanitized raw reply when it happened:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 742

<html>
<head><title>500 Internal Error</title></head>
<body>Upstream error ... model service returned 500</body>
</html>

customer_jim: SDK is redwood-js 0.8.4, but we also hit it with curl above.

eng_sophia: OK this is helpful. Root cause: when response_format=structured_json + json_mode=strict we expect the system to assert Content-Type startsWith application/json (and to reject otherwise). There's a regression where the error-path handler copies the upstream Content-Type header verbatim (including text/html) and returns 200 with HTML body under some 5xx->200 transform. Strict mode then tries to parse and fails client-side.

eng_sophia: Short-term workaround: set Accept header to exactly 'application/json; charset=utf-8' or add a client-side guard to treat HTML bodies as error and retry. Also disabling json_mode=strict will let SDK attempt tolerant parsing.

support_ryan: We can patch a gateway rule to force Content-Type: application/json for internal error envelopes, but need eng-runtime sign-off. I will open an internal incident and attach your logs.

eng_infra_bot: [incident-1234] Created incident for content-type enforcement on error response paths. Priority: P2.

customer_jim: Appreciate it — any ETA? This is causing our production parser to fail ~1% of requests when models hiccup.

eng_sophia: We'll aim for a rollback/patch in the next deploy window (24-48h). In the meantime, please add a quick client-side retry for 200 with html body or check Content-Type before parsing.

support_ryan: I'll follow up with a formal repro-ticket and link to the incident. Thanks for the detailed curl trace, Jim.

customer_jim: Thanks, Ryan. Workaround implemented and monitoring added. Will report if it persists. :thumbsup:
